description: The note-list sort rule (key in direction, then id ascending by code point; Name folds the title with the filename collision rule). Canonical in the Rust store; the browser-mode web harness mirrors it so Playwright and web dev see the same order the engine produces (ADR-0001 keeps every shipping shell comparator-free).
note: Partial: both sides pin the same surrogate-range tiebreak fixture (U+FDFD before U+1F600) and the same case-insensitive Name ordering, but no shared fixture file drives both. The harness is not a shipping shell; a shipping shell must never grow a comparator (AGENTS.md §12).
